sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Juggling anteater on a unicycle — building your animated SVG.

arguments.content:
<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>Anteater riding unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#E0F6FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFF8DC"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8BC34A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#558B2F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF59D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFEB3B" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Bottle symbol centered at 0,0 -->
    <g id="bottleShape">
      <!-- bottle body -->
      <rect x="-14" y="-10" width="28" height="42" rx="7" fill="#4CAF50" stroke="#1B5E20" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="-14" y="8" width="28" height="10" fill="#C8E6C9" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-28" width="12" height="20" fill="#4CAF50" stroke="#1B5E20" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="-34" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#795548" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="32" rx="14" ry="3.5" fill="#1B5E20" opacity="0.4"/>
      <!-- highlight -->
      <rect x="-10" y="-6" width="5" height="30" rx="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Juggling loop path (invisible, for reference) -->
    <path id="juggleLoop" d="M 360,250 Q 455,-30 550,250 Q 455,310 360,250 Z" fill="none"/>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="480" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="650" cy="90" r="60" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="650" cy="90" r="35" fill="#FFEB3B" stroke="#FBC02D" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g opacity="0.9" fill="white">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="45" ry="20" />
      <ellipse cx="30" cy="-8" rx="30" ry="18" />
      <ellipse cx="-30" cy="-5" rx="28" ry="15" />
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-50 100" to="850 100" dur="28s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="55" ry="22" />
      <ellipse cx="35" cy="-10" rx="32" ry="18" />
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="850 170" to="-100 170" dur="38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Distant hills -->
  <ellipse cx="150" cy="480" rx="250" ry="80" fill="#AED581" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="650" cy="485" rx="300" ry="90" fill="#9CCC65" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="480" width="800" height="120" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="480" width="800" height="8" fill="#33691E"/>
  <!-- moving ground dashes for forward motion -->
  <g stroke="white" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7" stroke-dasharray="40 40">
    <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="800" y2="540"/>
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="80" to="0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="490" rx="110" ry="14" fill="black" opacity="0.2">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="110;100;110" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- ===== UNICYCLE + ANTEATER RIG ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- slight forward bob of whole rig -->
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -8; 0 0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    
    <!-- Unicycle wheel -->
    <g>
      <!-- tire -->
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="80" fill="#212121"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="66" fill="#FAFAFA"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="62" fill="none" stroke="#9E9E9E" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- rotating spokes + crank -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 400 400" to="360 400 400" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <g stroke="#616161" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="400" y2="342"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="450" y2="371"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="450" y2="429"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="400" y2="458"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="350" y2="429"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="350" y2="371"/>
        </g>
        <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="12" fill="#FF5722" stroke="#BF360C" stroke-width="3"/>
        <!-- pedals/cranks -->
        <g stroke="#212121" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="376" y2="430"/>
          <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="424" y2="370"/>
        </g>
        <rect x="360" y="425" width="28" height="12" rx="3" fill="black"/>
        <rect x="412" y="363" width="28" height="12" rx="3" fill="black"/>
      </g>
      <!-- fork -->
      <g stroke="#D32F2F" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
        <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="385" y2="275"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="400" x2="415" y2="275"/>
      </g>
      <rect x="372" y="256" width="56" height="20" rx="10" fill="#212121"/>
      <rect x="372" y="256" width="56" height="8" rx="4" fill="#424242"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Anteater legs pedaling (simplified, pumping up/down opposite) -->
    <g stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <!-- far leg -->
      <g stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="16">
        <line x1="385" y1="270" x2="374" y2="430">
          <animate attributeName="y2" values="430;368;430" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <animate attributeName="x2" values="374;426;374" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <!-- near leg -->
      <g stroke="#A1887F" stroke-width="17">
        <line x1="410" y1="270" x2="426" y2="370">
          <animate attributeName="y2" values="370;430;370" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <animate attributeName="x2" values="426;374;426" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Anteater body -->
    <g>
      <!-- big bushy tail (wagging) -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 320 220; 8 320 220; -6 320 220" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M 330,210 C 260,160 220,200 200,270 C 190,310 230,340 270,330 C 300,300 320,260 340,235 Z"
          fill="#6D4C41" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M 305,220 C 270,200 245,220 235,260" fill="none" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
        <path d="M 315,240 C 285,230 260,245 255,275" fill="none" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
      </g>

      <!-- body -->
      <ellipse cx="395" cy="210" rx="85" ry="55" fill="#BCAAA4" stroke="#4E342E" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- anteater stripe: dark chevron -->
      <path d="M 360,170 L 395,210 L 360,250 L 340,242 L 370,210 L 340,178 Z" fill="#212121" stroke="#FAFAFA" stroke-width="3"/>
      <!-- back leg haunch -->
      <ellipse cx="385" cy="245" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#A1887F" stroke="#4E342E" stroke-width="3"/>

      <!-- long snout / head facing right -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 460 190; -4 460 190; 0 460 190" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M 450,180 C 490,175 530,165 560,145 L 565,155 C 535,180 495,195 455,205 Z"

        <circle cx="561" cy="150" r="4" fill="#4E342E"/>

        <circle cx="455" cy="182" r="7" fill="black"/>
        <circle cx="457" cy="180" r="2.2" fill="white"/>
        <path d="M 430,155 L 438,135 L 450,153 Z" fill="#8D6E63" stroke="#4E342E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <!-- smiling mouth line -->
        <path d="M 545,158 Q 555,160 560,150" fill="none" stroke="#4E342E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>

      <!-- juggling arms (up, waving) -->
      <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
        <path d="M 430,210 Q 460,180 485,150" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="14">
          <animate attributeName="d" values="M 430,210 Q 460,180 485,150; M 430,210 Q 465,175 495,145; M 430,210 Q 460,180 485,150" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
        <path d="M 415,215 Q 425,180 420,140" stroke="#A1887F" stroke-width="14">
          <animate attributeName="d" values="M 415,215 Q 425,180 420,140; M 415,215 Q 435,175 435,135; M 415,215 Q 425,180 420,140" dur="0.8s" begin="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
      </g>
      <!-- hands -->
      <g fill="#4E342E">
        <circle cx="485" cy="150" r="9">
          <animate attributeName="cy" values="150;145;150" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <circle cx="420" cy="140" r="9">
          <animate attributeName="cy" values="140;135;140" dur="0.8s" begin="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
      </g>

      <!-- little scarf for flair -->
      <path d="M 425,205 Q 400,225 380,220" fill="none" stroke="#D32F2F" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g>
        <rect x="370" y="218" width="18" height="30" rx="4" fill="#D32F2F" transform="rotate(-20 379 233)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-20 379 233; -10 379 233; -20 379 233" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
        </rect>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== JUGGLING BOTTLES ===== -->
  <!-- Three bottles on same loop, staggered -->
  <g>
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
        <mpath href="#juggleLoop"/>

      <g>

    <g>

    <g>

      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="-360" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <!-- motion sparkles on bottles -->
  <g fill="#FFF176" opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="455" cy="80" r="4">

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
